attack_parameters.description: 2.6.1: Spoofer is stationary in a vehicle, roof antenna at ~69.212409N,15.858314E. Spoofed signals (GPS L1 only) at 10 dBm begin at true position/time. After 10 minutes, the spoofed position starts moving south at 40 km/h while the real spoofer stays still. Simultaneous jamming on GLONASS G1 at 10 dBm. Scenario runs until 10:35.
